newsitem.title: USA: Stericycle to stay active in mergers in '97.
newsitem.headline: Stericycle to stay active in mergers in '97.

text.p: Stericycle Inc said Tuesday it expects to remain active in acquiring medical waste service providers over the next year, even as it integrates a recently acquired company into its operations.

The company, which reported a loss of $809,000 or $0.08 a share in the period ended December 31, said acquisition opportunities remain robust as the medical waste treatment market feels pressure to consolidate.
Stericycle recently acquired the majority of the medical waste services assets of a WMX Technologies Inc unit.
Stericycle, a provider of regulated medical waste management services, lost $794,000, or $0.11, a year ago.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Tuesday at 8-7/8.
